purpose: Persist the exact private zero-case LiveBench inference outcome, including any transitive runtime exception, without reading terminal cases.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json, traceback, subprocess
receipt={
  "schema":"PROJECT_BRAIN_LIVEBENCH_PRIVATE_TRANSITIVE_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTIC_V1",
  "terminal_case_content_read":False,
  "terminal_cases_consumed":0,
  "paid_external_model_or_api_used":False,
}
expected={
 "canonical/runtime/astra_runtime.py":"7f5d16b1db69cb620954bc778e0ba6e15e687b75",
 "canonical/runtime/root2_livebench_if_astra_inference_adapter_v1.py":"7e3885fa7a6e56df656c066e0a8f17cfa21424e7",
 "canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py":"4b61fe911471854ec15c7900816f61e9e55f602e",
}
observed={}
for path,want in expected.items():
    got=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD:"+path],text=True).strip()
    observed[path]=got
    if got!=want:
        receipt.update(status="BLOCKED", blocker="FROZEN_BLOB_MISMATCH", path=path, expected=want, observed=got)
        print("LIVEBENCH_PRIVATE_DIAGNOSTIC_RECEIPT="+json.dumps(receipt,sort_keys=True))
        print("LIVEBENCH_PRIVATE_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE")
        raise SystemExit(0)
receipt["observed_git_blobs"]=observed
try:
    from canonical.runtime import root2_livebench_if_astra_inference_adapter_v1 as a
    req={
      "benchmark_id":"LIVEBENCH_IF_2026_06_25",
      "task_id":"SYNTHETIC_ZERO_CASE_INFERENCE",
      "allowed_tools":[],
      "task_payload":{"instruction":"Reply with exactly SYNTHETIC_OK."},
    }
    out=a.infer(req)
    receipt.update(
      status="PASS" if out.get("status")=="PASS__MODEL_INDEPENDENT_BRAIN_RESPONSE" and out.get("cognition_dependency_class")=="MODEL_INDEPENDENT" and out.get("model_dependency_count")==0 else "BLOCKED",
      adapter_status=out.get("status"),
      cognition_dependency_class=out.get("cognition_dependency_class"),
      model_dependency_count=out.get("model_dependency_count"),
      answer=out.get("answer"),
      provenance=out.get("provenance"),
    )
except BaseException as exc:
    receipt.update(
      status="BLOCKED",
      blocker_type=type(exc).__name__,
      blocker_message=str(exc),
      traceback=traceback.format_exc()[-10000:],
    )
print("LIVEBENCH_PRIVATE_DIAGNOSTIC_RECEIPT="+json.dumps(receipt,sort_keys=True))
print("LIVEBENCH_PRIVATE_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE")
PY
